s1.syndrome_frame: Asymptomatic facial swelling with reduced mouth opening and prior similar episodes
salient_findings: Asymptomatic swelling in the right lower half of the face
Reduced mouth opening
Gross right facial asymmetry
Ovoid subcutaneous swelling with ill-defined borders
Elevation of the right buccal mucosa
key_facts: First episode treated as buccal-space infection with incision and drainage
Swelling extended from the level of the right lateral canthus to 1 cm below the corner of the mouth
Mouth opening restricted by the mass
Contrast-enhanced CT showed a well-defined soft-tissue mass with cystic areas
Intracystic loculations with dense cystic content
Erosion of the posterior buccal cortex without perforation of the maxilla

differentials: Polycystic disease of the parotid gland
IgG4-related disease with salivary gland involvement
Rosai-Dorfman disease with salivary gland involvement
Langerhans cell histiocytosis with salivary gland involvement
per_call: Polycystic disease of the parotid gland
IgG4-related disease with salivary gland involvement
Rosai-Dorfman disease with salivary gland involvement
Langerhans cell histiocytosis with salivary gland involvement

shortlist.label: Buccal space abscess
shortlist.why_kept: Clinical diagnosis of a nonspecific chronic abscess with buccal-space involvement and CT findings of a well-defined soft-tissue mass with cystic areas

shortlist.label: Lipoma of the buccal space
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of a subcutaneous swelling with a leathery pouch-like appearance and no involvement of buccinator muscle or bone

shortlist.label: Keratocystic odontogenic tumor
shortlist.why_kept: CT findings of a well-defined soft-tissue mass with cystic areas and erosion of the posterior buccal cortex

shortlist.label: Pleomorphic adenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of a well-defined soft-tissue mass with cystic areas and a history of prior similar episodes

shortlist.label: Mucoepidermoid carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: CT findings of a well-defined soft-tissue mass with cystic areas and a history of prior similar episodes

raw.rationale: The lesion's characteristics, such as its long history, multiple recurrences, well-defined borders, and lack of signs of infection, are more consistent with a benign tumor like pleomorphic adenoma. The presence of a firm, irregular, leathery pouch-like appearance and the ease of excision also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Buccal space abscess
rejected.why: The absence of pain, fever, and lymphadenopathy, as well as the lesion's long history and multiple recurrences, make an abscess less likely.

rejected.label: Lipoma of the buccal space
rejected.why: The lesion's firm and irregular texture, as well as its leathery pouch-like appearance, are not typical of a lipoma.

rejected.label: Keratocystic odontogenic tumor
rejected.why: The lesion's location in the buccal space and its clinical presentation are not typical of a keratocystic odontogenic tumor, which is usually associated with the jaw bones.

rejected.label: Mucoepidermoid carcinoma
rejected.why: The lack of aggressive features, such as facial palsy, paresthesia, or significant bone destruction, makes a malignant tumor like mucoepidermoid carcinoma less likely.
